task: Take the BOX_MIDDLE of the box and place it on INSPECTION_TABLE. After that, the stack should look like it is removed the middle box ONLY. NOTE: only the top box of the box stack can be picked(like the data structure).
plan_summary: Navigate to the box stack, remove the top box (BOX_TOP) and temporarily place it on TEMP_TABLE to access BOX_MIDDLE. Pick BOX_MIDDLE and place it on INSPECTION_TABLE. Finally, retrieve BOX_TOP from TEMP_TABLE and place it back on BOX_BOTTOM to restore the stack structure without the middle box.
assumptions: Only the top box of the stack can be picked, requiring BOX_TOP to be moved first.
TEMP_TABLE is a valid and reachable location for temporary storage.
Placing BOX_TOP back onto BOX_BOTTOM will correctly reconstruct the stack.
NavTo tolerance of 1.5 ensures the robot stops within the 2.0 interaction distance required for Pick and Place.
